appearance_facts.fact: Title reads 'Shrinking Population of City A from 2010 to 2015'.
A single blue line rises steadily from the left (2010) to the right (2015), starting near the 2,000 gridline and ending just below the 3,000 gridline.
Vertical axis labeled 'Population' with ticks at 0, 500, 1,000, 1,500, 2,000, 2,500, 3,000, 3,500.
Horizontal axis labeled 'Year' with ticks 2010 through 2015.
